# Retained source boundary

`PREDECESSOR-NOTICE.md` is copied verbatim from Nick Petalas's PR3162 at
`ebd7fd275288e4a9f658e77fa77a0119a8322e74`. It describes that predecessor,
including files not copied here. This package retains only the six files in
`SOURCES.json.retained_files`. Their exact origin paths, blobs and SHA256 hashes
are recorded there and their working bytes are authenticated during replay.

The original TWOSIDE reduction and its predecessor attribution belong to
DreamingOfClouds, PR3154 at `708f0ad8928c383de8294aea3c126e9461d2066d`.
The flat/orbit and rank-six oracle lineage includes Nick Petalas's PR3161 at
`a1aba8389b87412e6f72ccf4d11f31e0ea232327`. All retained source is Apache-2.0;
`LICENSE` is copied unchanged. No credit for that work is claimed as a new result
in this successor.
